description: Kohinoor Mills Limited traces its listed existence to Kohinoor Weaving Mills, incorporated in 1987 and renamed Kohinoor Mills in 2006, and its textile history to 1948. Its 160-acre site in Lahore produces more than 100 million metres a year of grey, white and dyed fabric, supplied to fashion brands and retailers abroad, across weaving, dyeing and finishing divisions. The company also runs Kohinoor Genertek, an independent power plant of about 30 MW and 30 tonnes per hour of steam serving its own divisions, and began Kohinoor Apparel in 2025 to stitch garments in-house.
sourceNote: Written from: Kohinoor Mills Limited website (kohinoormills.com: about, products, profile, board of directors, contact) (accessed 2026-10-17)
